rationale: The permissionless product contract, APSS authority separation, exact VC judgments, certified primitive direction and retained deployment obligations resolve the earlier architecture objections. One material theorem-applicability qualification remains: PR17 statement soundness requires a substantive witness-side WShape premise, separately from producer-WT and source-side producer obligations. The candidate presently names only producer obligations when describing what must be discharged.

blocking_changes.change: In section 3 explicitly name WShape as a witness-side premise and require its relevant conditions to be enforced or derived for all adversarial accepted witnesses, separately from producer-SA/WT/WF2. State that checking the honest producer witness alone does not discharge this obligation.
blocking_changes.evidence: StatementSoundness.agda:5728 has producer-WT S -> satisfies(synth S) w -> WShape S w -> SubRealizer S w. WShape:2372-2446 includes assert true, exact less-than range, no-overflow, input guard/default and output typing conditions. Circuit assert is non-zero whereas preprocess assert requires Boolean true.

caveats: Advisory plan endorsement is not PR17 proof reproduction, concrete chip validation, cryptographic security proof or ledger acceptance.
The current ZKIRv3 surface must be bound independently of the older 34-instruction/13-type model; accepted use of only old names does not establish unchanged semantics.
Finite VC/mutation tests remain distinct from encoding adequacy and arbitrary-witness soundness.

Permission and private composition still require explicit authority, disclosure, revocation and cumulative-consumption semantics; repository review controls must remain outside independent developer deployment.
evidence_that_would_change_vote: An amended shared candidate explicitly separates and discharges the witness-side premise as above would resolve the sole current blocker.

A theorem establishing WShape from the supported source profile plus all accepted circuit witnesses, or an equivalent fully enforced relation with appropriate conclusions, could supply concrete technical closure later.
New evidence of unsafe source-to-target correspondence, unbound effects or administrative developer restrictions would reopen objections.
